newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares driven up by banks and forestry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares driven up by banks and forestry.

text.p: Swedish shares ended higher on Tuesday, supported by strong gains for the banking and insurance and forestry sectors.
The general index rose 0.54 percent to 2324.01 in turnover of 4.38 billion crowns.
The banking and insurance sector jumped 2.08 percent, lifted by Handelsbanken's leap. The share soared 8.5 crowns to 188.5 crowns.
"People think that Handelsbanken will buy Stadshypotek," a trader said. "It is the only bank that could pay in cash."
The forestry sector rose 1.34 percent on fundamentals and technical trading, despite slacking off some in the afternoon.
Telecommunications giant Ericsson also supported indices by climbing 3.5 crowns to 205 crowns.

Pharmaceutical company Astra belonged to the losers, however, as rumours about Swiss rival Roche planning a takeover bid faded. Rumours that investment company Investor is on the verge of selling its Astra stake also petered out.
The share dropped 6 crowns 339 crowns after sky-rocketing 13 crowns a day earlier on takeover speculation.
